North Beach to Sunset District: 27.
North Beach to Chinatown: 6.
North Beach to Russian Hill: 4.

5. Meet Anthony from 1:36PM to 2:30PM (54 minutes).
6. Travel to Russian Hill (5 minutes) to meet Rebecca at 2:35PM.
7. Meet Rebecca from 2:35PM to 9:15PM (400 minutes).
